title: Because: the analyst agent that shows its work

slides.title: Because
slides.subtitle: The analyst agent that shows its work. Ask why something happened and audit every claim.

slides.title: Why questions get fluent answers that nobody can check.
slides.body: LLMs explain fluently but unverifiably. Dashboards show what changed, never why. Doing it properly takes hours of pulling and lining up sources.
slides.notes: The problem: answering 'why did X change?' properly means pulling several sources, aligning periods, testing competing explanations and writing down what does not fit.

slides.title: Who it is for

items.heading: Analysts
items.body: Explain a margin or revenue move from filings in seconds, with the bridge in points of revenue.

items.heading: Journalists
items.body: Check a claimed cause of inflation or unemployment against official series before publishing.

items.heading: Students and investors
items.body: Learn to reason from evidence: see the hypotheses that failed, not just the answer.

slides.notes: Target users: anyone who has to defend a 'because' to a sceptical reader.

slides.title: Ask why then audit
slides.body: Intel's 2024 gross margin from SEC filings. Every claim cites findings; every finding cites a query and a source row.

slides.title: One investigation

items.heading: Scout
items.body: Classifies the question, runs the guard and issues an HMAC-signed contract for the allowed tools.

items.heading: Recall
items.body: H-MEM returns what the agent already believes and which query it came from.

items.heading: Query and test
items.body: Zetaris SQL pulls target and drivers. Each hypothesis gets a numeric rule and a verdict.

items.heading: Answer and remember
items.body: Cited claims, counter-evidence and confidence; every finding is written back with provenance.

slides.notes: The LLM is optional. Answers are computed from data first; an LLM may only rewrite findings and is rejected unless every sentence cites a finding and every number appears in the evidence.

slides.title: Architecture
slides.body: Meterless decides and remembers. Zetaris federates the data. The same portable SQL runs on a DuckDB fallback.
slides.notes: Scout -> Analyst -> DataHarness (ZetarisBackend over JDBC / UI proxy, DuckDB in SAMPLE_MODE) -> SEC EDGAR XBRL, ONS, FRED. H-MEM recall and write. Optional NVIDIA NIM narrative, validated.

slides.title: Sponsor technology
slides.body: Zetaris federates. Meterless decides and remembers.

slides.title: Zetaris is the data harness
slides.body: Three public source families federated by Lightning, queried with one portable SQL dialect.
slides.image_prompt: Real screenshot of the zetaris-e2e GitHub Actions workflow

items.heading: Tables
items.body: SEC, ONS as REST tables; FRED as FILESTORE CSV

items.heading: Channels
items.body: JDBC, UI SQL proxy or REST

items.heading: CI
items.body: Real Lightning bundle on GitHub Actions

slides.notes: Unique: FRED without an API key federated as FILESTORE CSV; REST tables CACHE TABLE'd after registration; companies registered lazily on first question; views reused never dropped. Workflow: .github/workflows/zetaris-e2e.yml.

slides.title: Meterless remembers why
slides.body: H-MEM stores beliefs with the query that produced them. Scout gates every tool call.
slides.image_prompt: Real screenshot of the Meterless card in the Because UI

items.heading: H-MEM
items.body: Every finding is a memory with SQL, rows and source URL. Conflict scan flags restated numbers.

items.heading: Scout Intent
items.body: Intent registry, five-layer guard, HMAC-SHA256 contracts with TTL and scope checks.

items.heading: Ask it why
items.body: Memory recall answers what it believes and audits the trail behind each belief.

slides.notes: Unique: memory provenance makes 'why do you believe this?' answerable across sessions. Prompt injection is refused by Scout before any tool runs (examples/outputs/guard-blocked.json).
